runtime/run.py: in Trainer.__init__ compute self._n_stages = 0 if cascade is None else int(getattr(cascade, 'n_stages', 1)); ValueError unless in (0, 1, 2); _n_stages == 2 requires self.level == 1 (ValueError); keep the PREV_LEVEL check. Linear step: _n_stages == 1 -> today's code verbatim; chain -> A_prev = cascade.linear(x, task) or with skip_on st = cascade.linear_stages(x, task); A_prev = CS.skip_to(skip, st['A4'], st['A']). Deform step: chain -> prev = cascade.deform(x) or with skip_on cascade.deform_stages + skip_to on U and U_inv (U4 / U4_inv). Everything after (pre-warp at P.LEVEL_SPACING[self.level], compose, losses) unchanged. _cascade_val_fn eval mode for a chain returns {'A', 'A_prev': st['A'], 'A_prev4': st['A4']}; _cascade_val_deform_fn eval mode for a chain adds U4, U4_inv, V4; train-mode outputs unchanged. _val_errors / _val_deform_errors append dicts for a chain. _frozen_baseline_metrics for a chain computes + caches val_<set>_frozen/... (from A / U, V) and val_<set>_frozen4/... (from A4 / U4, V4) with the same metric functions and groups; single-stage output unchanged. _validate_and_log: time validate() and add 'val/wall_s' to the logged and stored record only when self.level == 1. Update the module docstring 'Level cascade' section. _recal_input / recalibrate_bn need no change (they call cascade.linear / cascade.deform).

DEVIATION (local hardware): on the GTX 1080 at 6000 MB the level-1 DEFORM train step does not fit even TINY, N 2, AMP + full checkpointing + lean sampler + split + lean losses, T 1 and 3 label classes (probed); the traced deform validation forward (default sampler) also OOMs, and the float32 level-1 build pass with the deform decoder OOMs (build_model(2) without split). AMP eval forward at N 2 fits (~3.6 GB), the linear step ~1.1 GB. So the level-1 tests use AMP + split + build_model(1); the deform chain branches of the train step / validation are checked by tracing (skip ops absent at p 0, present at p > 0; eval outputs u,u_inv,v,v_raw,U,U_inv,V,U4,U4_inv,V4; train-mode outputs unchanged), skip_to on deform_stages eagerly, and _frozen_baseline_metrics on the chain's frozen fields (deform _frozen/_frozen4 keys finite, cached); T-C7 frozen-unchanged is asserted after executed linear steps and recalibrate_bn (rigid), not after a deform step. AMP first steps can be loss-scale skips, so the skip test asserts finite losses, not res['finite'].
